'''Tourism Promotion Services (TPS)''', doing business as '''Serena Hotels''', is a Kenyan [[hotel chain]] that operates hotels in [[East Africa]], [[Southern Africa]], [[Central Asia]], and [[South Asia]]. It is based in [[Nairobi]].

TPS is listed on the [[Nairobi Stock Exchange]] (NSE) and is a subsidiary of the [[Aga Khan Fund for Economic Development]] (AKFED).<ref>[https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-tpse-2023-ar-00/ TPS Annual Report 2023]</ref>

As of 2024, Serena comprises a collection of 35 hotels,<ref>{{cite web |title=TPS Eastern Africa (Serena) Limited (TPSE.ke) 2023 Abridged Report |url=https://africanfinancials.com/document/ke-tpse-2023-ab-00/ |website=African Financials |access-date=29 August 2024}}</ref> luxury resorts, and safari lodges which are located in East Africa ([[Democratic Republic of the Congo]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Serena expands its footprint into DRC with Goma hotel|url=https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/magazine/serena-expands-its-footprint-into-drc-with-goma-hotel--2302832|access-date=2020-09-23|website=The East African|language=en}}</ref> [[Kenya]], [[Tanzania]], [[Rwanda]], [[Uganda]], and [[Mozambique]]) and Central and South Asia ([[Pakistan]] and [[Tajikistan]]).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nation.co.ke/business/news/Serena+adds+Tanzanian+link+to+its+hotels+chain+/-/1006/1278730/-/n0lsu6/-/index.html |title=Overrview of Serena Hotels Group |website=www.nation.co.ke |date= |accessdate=2012-08-11}}</ref>

For many years, Serena Hotels was the only international hotel chain that operated in [[Afghanistan]]. On 1 February 2025, after nearly two decades of operating, Serena Hotels handed over the Kabul Serena Hotel in [[Kabul]] to the [[Taliban]] government-owned Hotel State Owned Corporation, which renamed it the [[Kabul Grand Hotel]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Kabul Serena Hotel operations handed over to Taliban-controlled corporation |url=https://amu.tv/154640/ |website=Amu TV |access-date=1 February 2025 |date=1 February 2025}}</ref>

extract:
Tourism Promotion Services (TPS), doing business as Serena Hotels, is a Kenyan hotel chain that operates hotels in East Africa, Southern Africa, Central Asia, and South Asia. It is based in Nairobi.
TPS is listed on the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) and is a subsidiary of the Aga Khan Fund for Economic Development (AKFED).
As of 2024, Serena comprises a collection of 35 hotels, luxury resorts, and safari lodges which are located in East Africa (Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda, Uganda, and Mozambique) and Central and South Asia (Pakistan and Tajikistan).
For many years, Serena Hotels was the only international hotel chain that operated in Afghanistan. On 1 February 2025, after nearly two decades of operating, Serena Hotels handed over the Kabul Serena Hotel in Kabul to the Taliban government-owned Hotel State Owned Corporation, which renamed it the Kabul Grand Hotel.
